Coenzyme Q10 
(Ubiquinone)
Possibly effective for age related 
macular degeneration, con-
gestive heart failure, diabetic 
neuropathy, HIV/AIDS, Hyper-
tension, Ischemic reperfusion 
injury, migraine headache, 
and Parkinson’s disease.
Doses vary from 30 mg 
-600 mg/day. 
Very few side effects reported 
other than mild nausea, head-
ache, and skin itching.

Creatine
Possibly effective for athletic 
performance enhancement 
(muscle mass and muscle 
strength). 
Usually taken as a loading 
dose (0.3 g/kg/day) fol-
lowed by a maintenance 
dose (0.03 g/kg/day).
Doses up to 30 g have been 
taken safely short term.
